name: Aldous's Charm
description: A worn charm from an old man's hand. At full HP, the holder survives any one hit with 1 HP, once per battle

name: Bramble's Collar
description: A Gogoat's old collar with BRAMBLE on the tag. The holder's friendship grows twice as fast

name: Oswin's Bedroll
description: A bedroll an old ranger made one winter, thinking you might turn up. One full rest for the whole team, anywhere. A fresh one is in the bag each new region

name: Ember's Collar
description: An old Arcanine's collar, the leather worn soft. The holder can't be burned

name: Crestline Bell
description: The last bell of the Crestline order, cast thirty years late. The holder is shielded from the extra effects of moves used on it, flinching among them
